capabilities: Write results in place of inline code
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; manual installation required. Rolling writes to the note on render, so opening a template note with pick: commands rolls them; keep templates unread or wrap commands in a code block. Makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to roll dice or random tables and write the result directly into a note.

relations.evidence: first built inside the Tag and Tally plugin and were moved out into this standalone plugin

summary: Inline-code roller that rolls markdown random tables, asks a yes/no oracle, and rolls tasks against a level, writing each result into the note.
